name: Claude Workspace
summary: A standing place for work shared with Claude.
detail: One project, two standing tasks, and a smart list. Everything else is the app's normal furniture — assignment, comments, subtasks — so it works on the phone with no new UI.

projects.name: Claude
projects.detail: Assign a task to "Claude" to put it in the queue. Comment on a task to say something; Claude replies in the same thread and you get a notification.

tasks.title: Briefing
tasks.notes:
The standing thread. Claude keeps the pinned note above current: what it is working on, what it last finished, what it is waiting on. Comment here to ask for something; the reply arrives in this thread and raises a notification on your phone.

The due date is parked a year out on purpose. This is a standing thread, not a deadline, and an overdue badge on it every morning would be noise.

tasks.title: How this works
tasks.notes:
Conventions, so you don't have to remember them.

TO GIVE CLAUDE WORK — assign a task to "Claude". Anything assigned to Claude and not completed shows up in `wf queue`. It works from the phone: open a task, set the assignee, done.

TO SAY SOMETHING — comment on any task. `wf poll` reports comments Claude hasn't seen, ignoring its own. Claude replies in the same thread and you get a notification, because an agent reply is treated as addressed to you without needing an @mention.

TO SEE WHAT IT HAS — Projects → Smart Lists → Claude. That's a saved filter on assignee, so it stays current on its own.

TO FOLLOW A LONG JOB — Claude ticks subtasks as it goes and keeps the pinned note current, so a task's own row tells you where things stand.

WHAT IT WON'T DO — delete anything. There is no destructive command, deliberately. And nothing moves while WorkFlow is closed on the Mac, in either direction.
